description: Pull teammates' docs and show open handoffs at session start; publish doc edits when a turn ends.

hooks.command: command -v apl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'The apl CLI is not installed, so docs in .apl/ are unavailable. Tell the user to install it with: bun i -g @ghmeier/agent-plan@latest'; exit 0; }; apl pull --quiet; echo 'Open handoffs in .apl/:'; apl ls --type handoff --status open --short
